test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting in a straight row facing the North. A is sitting in the centre of the row. G and E are sitting at the ends of the row. B is sitting to the immediate left of A. F is sitting to the immediate right of G. D is sitting to the immediate left of E. C is sitting to the second left of E. Who is sitting between G and B?
solution: The pattern followed here is: **Given: ** Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting in a straight row facing the North. 1) A is sitting in the centre of the row. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3584259ac405d7fdb92ed3fa82ce7983ad2553c6f7ed0e872acf7c3a10efd325.png] 2) B is sitting to the immediate left of A.
